story.title: Mistrial Declared in Lindsay Clancy Murder Case After Jury Fails to Reach Verdict
story.summary: A Massachusetts judge has declared a mistrial in the murder case against Lindsay Clancy after jurors were unable to reach a unanimous verdict. The trial was marked by its complexity, leading to a hung jury. Prosecutors have not yet decided whether to retry the case.

The deadlock was reported on Tuesday, prompting the judge to encourage the jurors to keep working towards a decision. If a verdict is not reached, the judge may consider alternative instructions for the jury.

Patrick Clancy expressed that facing another trial would be extremely painful for the family.
